# Victor Svizev

> Senior Magento / Adobe Commerce developer with 9+ years of experience in extension development, platform upgrades, compatibility engineering, Hyvä Theme, and Adobe App Builder. Based in Dresden, Germany; remote-first.

Certified Adobe Commerce Developer Expert (AD0-E725). Independent Magento extension vendor (VCT) on the Adobe Commerce Marketplace with 100+ sales and a 5.0 rating. Currently working at TechDivision GmbH, maintaining an ecosystem of 140+ Magento extensions. Speaks English, German, and Russian.
